summary: Professional markdown rendering, export, and publishing via MCP. Use when user asks to "render markdown", "export to PDF", "convert to DOCX", "create a document", "publish a document", "share a link", "make a slide deck", "diff two markdown files", "export to HTML", "create a shareable document", "sync docs from GitHub", or "generate an image of this markdown". Do NOT use for simple markdown editing, code generation, or general writing that doesn't need styled output.
